Premium Service From a Team You Can Trust

An exceptional customer experience from pickup to delivery is always the goal at OD. Every member of our award-winning team – from our Solutions Specialists and local customer service teams to dockworkers and drivers – treats your business like it’s our own. Leading the LTL freight industry in on-time deliveries and low claims, OD sets the standard for shipping excellence.

From Standard to Expedited LTL and everything in between, we offer a range of freight transportation services for businesses across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and beyond. Each OD service is backed by our on-time, damage-free promise.
Spot Volume/Full Pup Load Rates
Service to/from Canada and Mexico
Container Service to/from Hawaii, Alaska, and Puerto Rico
Truckload, Flatbed or Temp-Controlled Equipment
Get Started Shipping with OD

Connect with a local Solutions Specialist who will initiate an account set-up and establish customized pricing tailored to your specific shipping needs. You will gain access to every OD shipping service, credit terms for invoicing, and a custom shipping dashboard on ODFL.com.
OD’s Investments Create Your Competitive Advantage
Discover how Old Dominion's investments in fleet, technology, and people deliver reliable, on-time LTL freight shipping. Find out what sets OD apart.

Ensure fast, reliable, and on-time deliveries with OD Expedited LTL Services. Whether you need daily shipments or guaranteed delivery, we've got you covered.

Our Special Rollouts service delivers product launches or seasonal promotions to retailers on time and without damage, so you can be confident you’ll have a successful product rollout.

Shipping smarter starts with understanding your freight's density. Knowing how to calculate, classify, and optimize your shipments can significantly reduce costs and improve efficiency.

To be the premier transportation solutions company in domestic and global markets served.
To provide innovative solutions designed to exceed customer expectations, increase shareholder value and ensure the continued success of the OD company and our family of employees.

pages.raw_title: LTL, Expedited, Global, Truckload Shipping Services | ODFL
pages.raw_meta: Old Dominion Freight Line offers domestic, expedited, global and truckload services.
raw_blocks: Premium Service from a Team you can Trust

For more than 90 years, OD has been helping the world keep promises by providing premium transportation services to get your shipments delivered on-time and damage-free. From less than truckload shipping services, expedited, full truckload and everything in between, we offer a wide variety of freight delivery services to meet all your shipping needs. With an industry-leading on-time record and low claims rate, OD leads the way in providing a premium experience for our customers.

By setting up an account, you will have access to every OD shipping service as well as a local Solutions Specialist for account management, credit terms and competitive pricing tailored to your specific business needs.

OD's network of more than 260 Service Centers helps you manage your domestic LTL freight needs with confidence from coast to coast. Our nationwide coverage provides direct transit from door-to-door with reduced freight handling and some of the fastest transit times in the industry.

Ensure fast, reliable, and on-time deliveries for the most time-sensitive shipments with OD Expedited LTL shipping. Whether you need a guaranteed delivery, faster than standard transit, expedited air, or MABD retail solutions, we've got you covered.

Built for your most time-sensitive and specialized freight needs, OD Critical delivers when your shipments demand more. This service offers same-day delivery, complex job site handling, and unmatched flexibility.

In addition to our nationwide network of OD Service Centers, we are proud to offer global secure shipping throughout North America. We offer seamless service to and from Canada, Mexico, Hawaii, Alaska, and Puerto Rico.

OD offers container drayage services for your LCL and FCL shipments. With OD company drivers and chassis as well as hazmat certifications, we handle container shipments with the same premium level of service you experience with OD LTL.
Whether it’s by ocean or air, streamline your import and export shipments with OD. Contact us today for secure, reliable, and efficient international freight services you can trust.
Get reliable and efficient truckload services across North America. OD Truckload Brokerage offers dry van, flatbed, refrigerated equipment as well as solutions for special projects.
Trade Show, Grocery and Food Service, and Security Divider are several of the specialized shipping services OD offers to meet the demands of any shipping need.
How Does LTL Pricing Work? What to Discuss With Your Carrier
Understand the LTL pricing structure and how it works before shipping. Knowing the basics of LTL pricing and invoice elements saves time, money, and stress.

Optimize logistics and supply chain management for a resilient supply chain. Improve supply chain planning & optimization with our expert guide.
